findings.description: Direct sit and crouch renders show the overskirt kicked behind the thighs, leaving the fitted shorts conspicuous across the lap. The pose-matched geometric diagnostic measured overskirt upper-thigh coverage at 25.4% left / 25.6% right when sitting and 36.5% / 36.9% when crouching, while under-shorts coverage was 95.5% and 95.4%; this is a coverage observation, not a fit pass.

The neutral and turntable views still show irregular crumpled/faceted folds rather than controlled sewn pleats. The v19 hem-follow weight experiment did not resolve the visual form, and the seated side profile visibly kicks out behind the hips.
The back view still does not clearly reveal an attached rear adjustment tab or buckle; the feature remains low-contrast and nearly flush with the waist/skirt seam.
Jacket seam trim and elbow quilting remain faint against the mostly plain ivory surface, and the outfit still lacks the intended fencing-set detail definition.
No authored UV layout exists for the current weighted garment mesh; UV status remains NOT_CREATED.

sourceEvidence.currentPrototypeMotif: V19 kept the waist Hips-anchored and raised skirt hem thigh-follow weights (hem .72, forward hem .18, centerline .48; cap .75). Five views and six poses were directly inspected. Sit/crouch still throw the overskirt behind the lap; measured upper-thigh overskirt coverage remains 25.4-25.6% sitting and 36.5-36.9% crouching versus 95.4-95.5% under-shorts coverage. Irregular surface folds and weak rear-tab/jacket details remain.

nextAction: REJECT. Keep the garment as an unapproved prototype. Change the overskirt panel pattern and sewn-pleat construction to retain a coherent front drape over the lap in sit and crouch; do not rely on hem thigh-follow weights alone. Preserve opaque fitted shorts coverage. Reduce irregular faceting, make the rear tab and buckle visibly attached, and strengthen jacket seam/elbow detailing. Then build through the normal pipeline and directly inspect all five views and six poses. UV, fit, Unity/VRChat runtime, package, and release remain unverified or blocked.
